We have mapped_rxn already in result. It is:

'[CH:14]#[C:15][Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19].O=[C:5]([C:3]([O:2][CH3:1])=[O:4])[CH2:6][CH2:7][c:8]1[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]1>>[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]'

Now we need to construct route JSON. Need target molecule SMILES: product of reaction. That's the product side of mapped_rxn: after >>. That SMILES is:

[CH3:1][O:2][C:3](=[O:4])[C:5]1(/[CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2)[CH:14]=[C:15]1[Si:16]([CH3:17])([CH3:18])[CH3:19]

We can strip atom mapping numbers to get SMILES. Remove [CH3:1] etc. Let's convert: [CH3:1] -> CH3, [O:2] -> O, [C:3] -> C, (= [O:4]) -> =O, [C:5]1 -> C1, then (/ [CH:6]=[CH:7]/[c:8]2[cH:9][cH:10][cH:11][cH:12][cH:13]2) -> ( /C= C /c2cccc c2 ) but need proper SMILES. Let's reconstruct:

CH3 O C(=O) C1( /C=C/ c2c c c c c2 ) C= C1 Si(CH3)(CH3)CH3

Better to use known product: likely the target molecule is something like "COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1" is one precursor, other is "C#C[Si](C)(C)C". The product is maybe "COC(=O)C(=O)C=C[Si](C)(C)C"? Not sure.

But we can just use the product SMILES with mapping removed. Let's produce product_smiles by removing brackets and colon numbers. We'll do simple removal: replace patterns like [X:...]. So:

[CH3:1] -> CH3
[O:2] -> O
[C:3] -> C
[O:4] -> O
[C:5]1 -> C1
[CH:6] -> C
[CH:7] -> C
[c:8]2 -> c2
[cH:9] -> c
[cH:10] -> c
[cH:11] -> c
[cH:12] -> c
[cH:13] -> c
[CH:14] -> C
[C:15]1 -> C1
[Si:16] -> Si
[CH3:17] -> CH3
[CH3:18] -> CH3
[CH3:19] -> CH3

Thus product SMILES: CH3O C(=O) C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1Si(CH3)(CH3)CH3

Combine: "COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1Si(C)(C)C". Need correct parentheses: Si(CH3)(CH3)CH3 is Si(C)(C)C.

Thus product SMILES: "COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1Si(C)(C)C". That seems plausible.

Now construct JSON:

{
 "type":"mol",
 "smiles":"COC(=O)C1(/C=C/c2ccccc2)C=C1Si(C)(C)C",
 "children":[
   {
     "type":"reaction",
     "template_id":1914386,
     "children":[
        {"type":"mol","smiles":"C#C[Si](C)(C)C"},
        {"type":"mol","smiles":"COC(=O)C(=O)CCc1ccccc1"}
     ]
   }
 ]
}

Check that precursor SMILES match given list. Yes.

Now verify route schema using verify_route.
Let's call verify_route.
